feedback_note: Our first Codex-researched edition pairs fresh court style with useful paddle news and stories of lifelong play. No reader reviews have arrived yet. Leave a comment in English or Chinese; a score is optional, and your feedback will shape the next search.
feedback_note_zh: 第一期 Codex 研究精选，带来新鲜穿搭、实用球拍动态和不同年龄的社群故事。目前尚未收到读者评论。欢迎用中文或英文留言，评分可选；你的反馈将帮助我们寻找下一期内容。

stories.title: Polka dots, sky blue, and a little doubles coordination
stories.title_zh: 波点、天空蓝，还有双打搭档的穿搭默契
stories.summary: Pickleball.com’s November 9 fashion roundup finds personality at the Opendoor World Championships: a coordinated white-and-blue mixed doubles pairing and Marcela Aguila Ampon’s black-and-white polka-dot dress. A quick lookbook for readers who enjoy bringing their own style to the court.
stories.summary_zh: Pickleball.com 在 11 月 9 日发布的世锦赛穿搭精选中，记录了混双搭档的白色与天空蓝配色，以及 Marcela Aguila Ampon 的黑白波点裙。喜欢在球场上展现个人风格的读者，可以从中寻找灵感。
stories.why: An easy starting point for your feedback: more pro-player inspiration, or more affordable everyday outfits?
stories.why_zh: 你更想看职业球员的穿搭灵感，还是更平价、日常的搭配？欢迎留言告诉我们。

stories.title: A quiet paddle still needs to meet performance standards
stories.title_zh: 安静的球拍，也需要符合性能标准
stories.summary: USA Pickleball’s November 9 statement names six OWL Sport models whose performance changed with use during testing. The organization says those models have a transition period through January 31, 2028, and will lose approval for its sanctioned competition on February 1, 2028. The original notice lists the affected models.
stories.summary_zh: USA Pickleball 在 11 月 9 日的公告中列出六款 OWL Sport 球拍，称测试发现其性能会随使用发生变化。公告规定过渡期截至 2028 年 1 月 31 日，相关型号将从 2 月 1 日起不再获准用于其认证赛事。具体型号见原文。
stories.why: Useful equipment context: quiet-category technology and competition approval are separate questions. Check the dated original notice for details.
stories.why_zh: 实用装备背景：静音技术与赛事认证是两个不同问题。具体信息请以有日期的原始公告为准。

stories.title: More than a score: a Chinese story of lifelong play
stories.title_zh: 不只看比分：一则关于长期打球的中国故事
stories.summary: A September feature in China Sports Daily, republished by the All-China Sports Federation, follows a Changsha pickleball exchange for older adults. It describes 32 teams and 390 athletes and accompanying staff, with women’s doubles, mixed doubles, and friendships across regions. This is a background read, rather than breaking news.
stories.summary_zh: 中华全国体育总会网站转载的《中国体育报》九月特写，记录了长沙的一场老年人匹克球交流活动。32 支队伍、390 名运动员及随队人员参加，项目包括女双、混双等。报道也写到跨地区的球友情谊。这是一篇背景读物，并非即时新闻。
stories.why: An exploratory read about designing a welcoming playing community around participation and connection.
stories.why_zh: 从参与与交流出发，看看一个友好的打球社群可以是什么样子。
stories.source: 中国体育报 · 中华全国体育总会

stories.title: Pickleball’s community story reaches senior living
stories.title_zh: 匹克球的社群故事，延伸到老年生活社区
stories.summary: USA Pickleball announced Cogir Senior Living as its official senior living partner on October 21. The announcement describes a focus on active lifestyles and social connection, including an athlete lounge at the 2026 Nationals. This is the organizations’ own partnership announcement, rather than an independent assessment of its results.
stories.summary_zh: USA Pickleball 于 10 月 21 日宣布 Cogir Senior Living 成为其官方老年生活社区合作伙伴。公告关注活跃生活和社交联系，并介绍了在 2026 年全国赛设置运动员休息区的安排。这是机构自身的合作公告，并非对项目效果的独立评估。
stories.why: A trend to follow: how organizations make room for social play at different stages of life.
stories.why_zh: 一个值得持续观察的方向：不同机构如何为不同人生阶段的社交打球创造空间。
